COMPACT FULL CERTIFICATE Reserve M26_C27.
Each q-symbol denotes its exact rational number; each p-symbol denotes the
  polynomial name below.
Every row lists all successive lower/upper slopes,  all linked heights,  the
  strict total upper numerator N with denominator 10^10,  and the full ordered
  cell trace.
A trace q/p uses its previous right endpoint as the left endpoint (initially 0).
  It selects polynomial p until right endpoint q. No cell is omitted.
Integrate each selected polynomial by the binomial antiderivative formula and sum;
  that exact rational total is strictly below N/10^10.
